terra.problem: The bakery-window comparison merely repeats climbing instead of using the gate. It doesn't land as a joke.
Saying nervous people still use the door adds an unsupported claim about the climber and nervous people.
The text says the shepherd enters by the gate, not that the gate belongs to him.
The text says the shepherd calls his own sheep by name, not that he gives every one of them a name.
The passage says the shepherd goes ahead, but it does not say there is no pushing or herding from behind, or that the sheep know he is up front.
Calling a shepherd at the back a confused crowd watcher puts down a person in the comparison.
The passage says Jesus spoke to them again; it does not say He did not walk away.
Saying there is nothing left to guess overstates how much Jesus has explained at this point.
The verse says the sheep did not listen. It does not say they recognized those voices as not being the shepherd's, or give that as their reason.
